title: Update annotation
description: Update an existing annotation by ID. You can change its text (`content`), when it happened (`date_marker`, ISO 8601), its visibility scope (`project` or `organization`), or its `emoji`. Only the fields you provide are updated.

methodDocumentation.text: Create, Read, Update and Delete annotations. [See docs](https://posthog.com/docs/data/annotations) for more information on annotations.

Update an existing annotation by ID. You can change its text (`content`), when it happened (`date_marker`, ISO 8601), its visibility scope (`project` or `organization`), or its `emoji`. Only the fields you provide are updated.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
Annotation visibility scope: `project`, `organization`, `dashboard`, or `dashboard_item`. `recording` is deprecated and rejected.

* `dashboard_item` - insight
* `dashboard` - dashboard
* `project` - project
* `organization` - organization
* `recording` - recording
